description: Manually reviewed operator specifications. Dates are review dates, not reception times. Refreshing never advances these dates. Original source records remain in raw and operation_versions.

corrections.reason: NOAA specifies 1694.1 MHz BPSK HRIT/EMWIN, 1.205 MHz necessary bandwidth, 400 kbps net data, and 927 ksymbols/s. SatNOGS lists FM and one duplicate GOES-19 record has a tenfold frequency error.
ARISS identifies HamTV as DVB-S with QPSK; SatNOGS mode field says DVB-S2. Video is downlink only.

satnogs:kDkFdAcUdGsY5ubJtmrsiU.reason: Duplicate GOES-19 HRIT source record; same service after NOAA frequency correction. Retained for audit, not counted twice.

retired_satellites.reason: NOAA explicitly lists these spacecraft as decommissioned. Being physically in orbit does not make them operational.

AMSAT explicitly reports end of mission, departure to solar orbit, or operator shutdown. A nonworking repeater alone is not used as a retirement criterion. AO-95 is deliberately retained because its beacon is listed as operational.
